property_summary: After any successful fallback call that sends exactly 10 ether and advances time, the correct contract either pays out its balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0 (so contract balance becomes 0) or keeps funds otherwise, but specifically: whenever block.number is a multiple of 15 the reference C ends with address(c).balance == 0 while the mutant M (which removed the conditional transfer) will leave address(c).balance == 10 ether, so the invariant is that for any admissible inputs with block.number % 15 == 0, address(c).balance == 0 (reference) — the bug breaks this.
change_summary: Remove the conditional transfer so the contract never pays out on multiples of 15, changing balance and subsequent observable behavior.
